context_narrative.description: Synthesized narrative context for the next single-document agent. Max ~800 words. Structure: (1) what we know — salient patterns, (2) what we're exploring — active questions, (3) what to look for — attentional directive.

consolidated_patterns.description: Behavioral patterns observed across multiple documents. Only include patterns seen in ≥2 documents.

pattern.description: Description of the recurring behavioral pattern.

documents_count.description: Number of documents where this pattern has been observed.

associated_category.description: Category that captures this pattern, if any.

variation_notes.description: How this pattern varies across documents.

active_categories_summary.description: Summary of categories currently active (being densified).

status.description: growing = new properties being added. stable = no recent changes. new = emerged in last batch.

concern_label.description: Which concern this category is linked to.

knowledge_gaps.description: Theoretical questions or behavioral areas not yet covered. What do we NOT know?

gap_description.description: What question remains unanswered or what behavior hasn't been observed.

priority.description: How important is it to fill this gap?

could_next_document_address.description: true if the next document might reasonably address this gap.

what_to_look_for.description: Concrete description of what would fill this gap.

attentional_directive.description: Specific instructions for A1/A2/A3 agents analyzing the next document. What should they prioritize? What patterns should they compare against? What gaps should they try to fill? 2-4 sentences.

concern_convergence.description: Assessment of whether concerns are converging.

is_converging.description: true if evidence is converging toward a specific concern.

leading_concern.description: The concern with the most supporting evidence.
